scope: Gate-RTL0.1 hierarchy and unique-owner closure only; no synthesizable RTL, timing, controller, macro, or PPA selection.

modules.name: route_a_kv_subsystem_top
modules.role: Composes frozen children and exports only the later manifest-defined boundaries; owns no duplicate protocol state.

modules.name: route_a_lifecycle_adapter
modules.role: Owns post-decision lifecycle authority, source dispatch, terminal association, init gating, and retirement coordination.

modules.name: route_a_hot_source_path
modules.role: Owns hot-source residency and serves the hot input to the common source/merge path.

modules.name: route_a_s2_gqa_source_wrapper
modules.role: Owns two S2 slot identities, generations, READY state, and four-consumer GQA release accounting.

modules.name: route_a_direct_pending_endpoint_v1
modules.role: Owns direct pending-delivery transport association and its stale-response exclusion.

modules.name: route_a_core_side_arbiter
modules.role: Owns frozen dependency predicates, eligible-class selection, FIFO ordinal preservation, and the grant cursor.

modules.name: route_a_core_mem_if_v1
modules.role: Owns core-side memory transaction identity, fragment ordering, terminal status, reset epoch, and external-memory boundary.

modules.name: route_a_m2_p3_wrapper
modules.role: Owns M2 private groups, P3 stage generations/state, sidecar binding, payload-durable dependency, and publication request/ack handshakes.

modules.name: route_a_page_manager
modules.role: Owns active stream descriptors, allocator availability, page generation, descriptor maintenance preparation, visibility, and per-page reclaim.

modules.name: route_a_merge_boundary
modules.role: Owns only observable merge packet state and numeric-fault production behind the frozen replaceable R4 boundary.

environment_endpoints.name: frontend_post_decision_adapter
environment_endpoints.role: Supplies score-free immutable lifecycle events; it is outside the Route-A DUT hierarchy.

environment_endpoints.name: external_memory_adapter
environment_endpoints.role: Terminates core_mem_if_v1 and owns native controller/CDC behavior outside the Route-A DUT hierarchy.

environment_endpoints.name: runtime_session_manager
environment_endpoints.role: Supplies logical session retirement and receives retirement acknowledgement outside the Route-A DUT hierarchy.

owner_claims.transfer_boundary: No mutable architecture state is replicated in the top shell.
Only maturity disposition and metadata_publish_commit may change authority; R4 numeric_fault is consumed here as the one outward terminal fault.
Lifecycle accepts arrival/maturity events; hot service leaves only through the source wrapper/merge boundary.
A slot reaches READY only for its current identity/generation and releases only after all four consumer updates commit.
Pending delivery is direct only; stale response suppression is owned at this endpoint and cannot alter S2 state.
R2 issues only accepted eligible requests to R1; ready-low does not advance cursor, candidate, ownership, credit, mask, or admission.
All pending/packed payload, sidecar, and descriptor-region traffic uses this one external-memory path.
R1 write commit is payload durable only; R3 accepts publication prerequisites but does not own page visibility or lifecycle authority.
R4 exposes the frozen packet/fault boundary only; it cannot release sources, change authority, or produce an outward terminal outcome itself.
R5 prepares and reclaims descriptors; visibility changes only inside metadata_publish_commit and physical reuse follows durable invalidation.
The lifecycle adapter owns retire acceptance and the one global drain predicate; R5 alone performs per-page reclaim after that predicate holds.

connections.purpose: Score-free session, arrival, maturity, attention, and retirement events.
Hot arrival/maturity ownership handoff and hot-source service selection.
Packed-source S2 fill requests under frozen GQA ownership and release rules.
Direct pending delivery request under the R2 direct_pending class.
P3 readiness/ownership predicates for pack read and write requests.
Descriptor maintenance requests using the separate FIFO-ordered R2 client.
Only selected and accepted core-side read/write transactions reach R1.
One core-side memory boundary for payload, sidecar, and descriptor traffic.
R3 outer metadata_publish_commit includes R5 descriptor visibility and lifecycle authority transfer.
Committed hot/pending/packed partials enter the canonical R4 merge boundary.
Merge response or numeric_fault becomes the one outward terminal result only after GQA commit.
External logical retirement request and matching acknowledgement boundary.
